scope_rule: The original eight are a required historical subset. Completion requires the exact current resolved MAIN/LAUNCHER package/component set from a qualified, current-epoch runtime query. Historical targets.json or a 45-app count is not current inventory.

current_observation.note: Existing qualification is identity-only. Retired reDroid and older Main epochs do not authorize current actions.

proposed_acceptance_thresholds.note: 60-minute continuous monitoring, three app restarts and three offline/online recoveries are newly proposed minimums. A real runtime restart needs a newly qualified epoch and repeat current-epoch app evidence. Update policy pins only after qualification; never reuse an old epoch.

safety_rules.integrity_and_security: Commercial integrity failures, permission restrictions and other effective security constraints remain BLOCKED; no bypass exception. Existing system permissions are observed, not inferred from store declarations.

framework_trust.note: Pin independent official/source-owner build provenance; current framework identity is not evidence of latest-version acceptance.

generic_launcher_app_schema.rule: Register each newly discovered package under apps with its actual public core operations and reviewed publisher/update source. System apps use their real platform/OEM update source. A generic startup or screenshot does not settle an app-specific operation.

cleanup_policy.cleanup_plan_entry_type: regular_file only; enumerate obsolete tree files individually; this audit does not authorize recursive directory deletion

evidence_contract.input: One JSON object. --template emits UNKNOWN placeholders. Null, unknown, missing, stale, or unsupported entries block acceptance. Duplicate JSON keys and non-finite numbers are invalid.
evidence_contract.canonical_digest: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON with sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(comma,colon), allow_nan=False.

record.scope: production; historical/test-cell results cannot satisfy this gate

binding.app_identity_sha256: canonical digest of app.current_identity; app records only

record.evidence_refs: nonempty list of unique IDs in references

reference.kind: exact required report kind checked by evaluator
reference.uri: absolute local artifact path or original source URI; do not include credentials
reference.sha256: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters of actual report bytes
reference.binding: same binding as the record, except independent official release/provenance sources

evidence_contract.runtime: identity must exactly match required_runtime_identity; helpers contains SHA-256 for sidecar, UI Automator, Chinese-input and location helpers and equals qualified_helpers. Qualification, admission, before/after guards and restart-requalification require separate bound reports. UI/install false always blocks.
evidence_contract.launcher_inventory: current_runtime_query; complete=true; joined processes; exit 0; Android user 0; exact MAIN/LAUNCHER resolution; rows [{package,components:[package/component],app_class:system|third_party}]. resolved_set_sha256 hashes rows sorted by package with each components array sorted. apps keys must equal this set.
evidence_contract.current_identity: package, android_user=0, uid, version_name, version_code, apk_sha256s, signer_sha256s; identity_before and identity_after must be byte-equivalent JSON values. Changing install UID/version/artifacts invalidates all app checks.
evidence_contract.official_candidate: status=artifact_verified; latest_stable_for_target, complete_apk_set_obtained, installed_apk_set_equal all true; reviewed official source_url; release_refs and bound artifact_manifest_refs; version_name/code equal installed identity and known candidate pin. apks enumerate base and every required split, each with package/version_code, hash, bytes, split_name; base includes min_sdk.
evidence_contract.APK_signature: Each APK has signature {tool:apksigner,verified:true,full_apk_checked:true,held_file_unchanged:true,verifier_joined:true,tool_exit_code:0,timed_out:false,signer_sha256s:[...],verified_schemes:{...},evidence_refs:[...]}. Signer set must match both installed identity and policy independent official vendor_trust.allowed_signer_sets. Mathematical signature validity alone is insufficient.
evidence_contract.checks: startup, login_or_guest, core, network, storage, permissions, integrity, soak, restart, fault_recovery; each needs bound non-screenshot evidence. App-specific flow IDs must exactly match policy. See --template and evaluator for typed metrics; no defaults imply successful execution.
evidence_contract.retention: Bound report with final source/config/repro/receipt/resolution/cleanup-plan references, actual existence attestations, no unresolved items, and exact obsolete artifact path/hash/kind entries. No deletion occurs; current or retained artifact overlap blocks cleanup. current_artifact_paths is [{path,sha256}] and must cover the entire accepted current framework/APK hash set; a bound current_artifact_path_inventory reference is required. Obsolete entries require artifact_type=regular_file and canonical absolute paths. Root, dot segments, wildcards, directory trees and ancestor/descendant overlap with current or retained final paths are rejected.
evidence_contract.trust_limit: The auditor checks declarations and cross-bindings. It cannot authenticate invented JSON, read remote evidence or rerun cryptography. Referenced original reports remain the source of truth.
